BROWN AND BLACKFACE EXAMPLES

Super Photo Timeline

EARLY BROWNFACE APPEARANCE

1960 Fender Super

The pinkish cabinet, dark grille and two-speaker rear view show the earlier Super format. The speaker close-up supplies the readable code used above. These photographs preserve visible wear instead of presenting the amp as an untouched reference.

1960 FENDER SUPER
1960 FENDER SUPER

LATER BROWN SUPER

1962 Fender Super

The wheat grille contrasts with the 1960 example. Its rear image retains the two-ten arrangement and non-reverb identity. No blackface or silverface Super Reverb should be inferred from this cabinet.

1962 FENDER SUPER
1962 FENDER SUPER

BLACKFACE REVERB MODEL

1963 To 1967 Fender Super Reverb

The taller cabinet and reverb controls belong to the four-ten model. The paper AB763 chart is shown separately above. The archive’s date range is retained because the photographed ink stamp doesn’t support a more exact date.

5

TWO EXAMPLES FROM THE ARCHIVE

Read The Super’s Codes In Context

Start with the two-letter chart stamp when it survives. Joe’s Fender amplifier decoder uses A for 1951 in the year position and covers stamps used until about 1970. A printed circuit code is a separate kind of information. Fender amp serials don’t reliably establish the production year.

Next collect the speaker and transformer markings, keeping all four speakers separate on a Super Reverb. A single changed speaker may have a much later date than the other components. The control-pot reference adds another check when those markings are safely documented by a technician.

220014
A Speaker Code On The 1960 Super

The six-digit frame stamp is readable in Joe’s photograph. Any trailing mark is excluded from the transcription. Compare the component code with the cabinet and other dated parts; it is evidence about this speaker, not a complete production certificate for the amplifier.

1960 FENDER SUPER
AB763
The Super Reverb’s Printed Circuit

The chart clearly prints AB763. Its faded date-stamp letters aren’t sufficiently distinct to decode, so this guide leaves the month and year unstated. The archive identifies the amp within the 1963 to 1967 blackface period.

1963 TO 1967 FENDER SUPER REVERB
